high_risk_moment: Deterioration flag is absent while a patient is already declining
harm_description: A silent assistant is read as reassurance and the duty doctor escalates a declining patient later than the paper chart would have prompted
existing_controls: Standard early warning score chart remains on the ward
proposed_controls: Validate the vendor score on local patient data before trusting it and keep the chart authoritative over the assistant
human_oversight: Nurses continue scoring the chart independently and escalate on the chart alone regardless of what the assistant shows
monitoring_metric: Share of deterioration events not flagged before clinician recognition
trigger_threshold: Any missed event above the pre-pilot baseline in a weekly review
response_action: Pause the flag surface preserve logs and revert the ward to chart-only escalation

high_risk_moment: Alert fires on a stable patient during a busy shift
harm_description: Frequent low-value alerts create fatigue so real alerts get dismissed and trust in the ward workflow degrades
existing_controls: None documented for the pilot ward
proposed_controls: Cap alerts per shift require evidence links on every alert and tune thresholds against local data
human_oversight: Nurses can suppress an alert with a one-tap reason that is logged and reviewed weekly
monitoring_metric: Alert volume per shift and alert dismissal rate
trigger_threshold: Dismissal rate above 60 percent or more than 10 alerts per nurse per shift
response_action: Reduce alert scope investigate thresholds and re-tune before widening the pilot

high_risk_moment: Handover audio is transcribed into a drafted intake note
stakeholder: Patient with impaired or accented speech
harm_description: Fabricated sentences enter the note draft and a later reader treats them as what the patient or nurse actually said risking a wrong or dangerous clinical action taken on invented symptoms refusals or history
proposed_controls: Show the transcript beside the audio flag low-confidence spans and block auto-fill of clinical fields from transcript text
human_oversight: A clinician must read and sign every note and cannot sign a draft with unreviewed low-confidence spans
monitoring_metric: Rate of clinician edits and unresolved low-confidence spans per note
trigger_threshold: Any note signed with an unreviewed low-confidence span
response_action: Disable voice drafting for that ward and re-verify the speech pipeline before re-enabling

high_risk_moment: Speech pipeline performs worse for some speaker groups
harm_description: Transcription quality gaps mean some patients get less accurate records than others for the same care episode
existing_controls: None in place at pilot start
proposed_controls: Measure transcription error rates by speaker group and require an accessible manual intake path
human_oversight: Nurses offer manual intake whenever speech capture is refused or flagged as low quality
monitoring_metric: Transcription error rate gap between speaker groups
trigger_threshold: Any group gap that persists across two consecutive monthly reviews
response_action: Stop voice intake for the affected group and revert to manual entry while the gap is investigated

high_risk_moment: A patient or family member asks the ward tablet for health guidance
harm_description: If any patient-facing surface answers a clinical question the ward exposes vulnerable people to advice with no clinician in the loop
proposed_controls: Enforce clinician authentication on every surface and add a refusal plus human handoff for any clinical question from a non-clinician
human_oversight: Clinical safety officer signs off that no patient-facing advice path exists before each pilot ward goes live
monitoring_metric: Count of assistant responses served to non-clinician accounts
trigger_threshold: Any single response served to a non-clinician account
response_action: Disable the surface immediately notify the safety committee and review access logs
